subject: Post-call: Amaya security/compliance & data retention SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@amayahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@amayahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: security/compliance & data retention SLAs

Hi Carlos / Amaya team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps on the security/compliance and data retention items we discussed: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed its SOC 2 Type I in 2025 and has Type II in progress; we expect final Type II report Q2 2027. We can share a redacted SOC 2 summary and provide rolling evidence as it becomes available.
- GDPR / HIPAA: We support GDPR requirements and can sign a BAA for HIPAA-covered workflows. For PHI workloads we recommend Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) but can discuss compensating controls for Dedicated.
- Data retention & deletion SLAs (default hosted):
  - Primary customer data (conversation content, embeddings): configurable default 90 days; purged from active storage within 7 days of deletion request, fully removed from snapshots within 30 days.
  - Logs (application/ingest/logs): default retention 180 days; can be shortened for an additional configuration fee.
  - Backups / archives: retained up to 365 days by default; backup purge is a separate process — full removal from backups can take up to 90 days after the primary purge.
- Searchable audit logs: retained 180 days by default; extended retention available as an add-on.

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary-2026.pdf (summary), data-retention-deletion-slas-2027.pdf (detailed table).

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share the SOC 2 summary and the questionnaire template (attached).
2) Carlos / security: mark up the questionnaire with any showstoppers and we can schedule a kickoff call (30-45 min) to run through answers.
3) Marissa / Sales will follow up with pricing delta for reduced log/backups retention and BAA language.

If that aligns, I'll schedule the kickoff for next week — suggested window: Jan 22-23 (US morning).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@amayahealth.com>

Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security/compliance & data retention SLAs

Neha — thanks for the clear notes. A few clarifications we need before we kick off the vendor questionnaire: 

1) The backup purge window: you mentioned "up to 90 days" after primary purge. Can you confirm whether that 90-day window is fixed or can be shortened via contract (we need max 30 days for backups in our scope)?
2) Deletion SLA: you said fully removed from snapshots within 30 days — is that an SLA or an expected timeline? We need contractual language if possible.
3) SOC 2: will you be able to provide the Type II report once it's finalized, and in the meantime can you share the Type I report or a redacted version of evidence?
4) HIPAA BAA: procurement wants a BAA template upfront to review.

Also please confirm whether logs in backups are subject to the same purge window or retained per a separate policy.

If you can send the SOC summary and questionnaire, we’ll have our security team mark it up and propose a time for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Carlos
Head of Security Operations | Amaya Health
carlos@amayahealth.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security/compliance & data retention SLAs

Carlos — appreciate the detailed questions. Quick answers below and attached the items we discussed.

1) Backup purge window: the default hosted offering has backups retained up to 365 days, and the "up to 90 days" comment refers to the additional time needed to fully purge material from long-term backup snapshots after primary deletion. That 90-day backup purge window is negotiable for contract customers; we can offer a 30-day backup purge commitment in the contract for Dedicated or Private deployments, subject to a small operational fee. For hosted customers, we can include the 30-day backup purge as a contractual SLA if we agree to an appropriate commitment level.

2) Deletion SLA: we can contractually commit to removing data from active/primary storage within 7 days of a deletion request, and to purge from snapshot/backup systems within 30 days by default (and 30 days can be tightened to 30 days guaranteed or 90 days depending on the option — see attached table). We'll surface explicit SLA language for redline.

3) SOC 2: attached is a redacted SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2-summary-2026.pdf). We will provide the full Type II report once issued. The Type I evidence was used as baseline and summary is included.

4) BAA: we have a standard BAA template we can share; Marissa will attach/route it through legal.

5) Logs: logs stored in backups are subject to the backup purge policy (i.e., backups retention window). If you need logs purged independently of backups, we can configure separate log retention (e.g., 30/60/90/180 days) and purge policies — pricing may be affected.

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary-2026.pdf; data-retention-deletion-slas-2027.pdf; vendor-security-questionnaire-template.xlsx

Proposed next step: let's schedule a 30-45 minute kickoff on Jan 22 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the questionnaire and capture any showstoppers. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a shared Drive link with the attachments and redlineable SLA text.

Thanks,
